notes.title: FORGIVE FOR EVER DEMO has been released!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]What do you do when you're engulfed by endless solitude?  
Do you wait for someone to come and save you, or do you break through the chains that bind you, to attain true freedom?  

Come, reclaim the heart that belongs to you.  

No longer be deceived by lies, no longer be controlled by a world turned upside down. You have a life that is your own.  

The dark fairy tale-style card game FORGIVE FOR EVER DEMO is now officially available!![/b][/h1][p]

\[h2
______________________________________________________________

*Players will assume the role of the divine messenger, Raven, fulfilling the wishes of believers with diverse personalities. It is worth noting that to realize their desires, people must pay a corresponding price. When the time comes to pay the price, how will you respond?

In the official version of the game, three significant visitors will recount their tragic pasts to the divine messenger. As their stories unfold and investigations proceed, the truth gradually comes to light. Beware! Not all visitors are benign; do not be deceived.

In the DEMO version, players will encounter the first important visitor—Hide. This gentle child harbors a wish; listen carefully to their desire and proceed to make a deal with them.
______________________________________________________________

*The trial version includes only the first chapter's storyline, eight trading segments, and a chase scene. The gameplay duration is approximately one hour. The game features card mechanics, platform jumping, click interactions, chase sequences, and more.
As the divine messenger, players will use card gameplay in the Prayer Room to assist NPCs in realizing their wishes 🌕
Players must discern the correct choices based on the symbols on the cards and textual hints in the instructions, selecting the true desires of the wish-seekers and the inevitable prices they must pay, thereby successfully completing the transaction 🔮🔮
In the chase levels, you will navigate through the Ether Land, a place filled with bizarre structures that reflect the innermost thoughts of the visitors.
Be careful not to be caught by other divine messengers, and be sure to defend against and counter their attacks!!
This is a dark fairy tale-style card game. If interested, feel free to add it to your wishlist~
We hope for your support and attention ❤❤❤
\[/h2]
______________________________________________________________

No matter what kind of pain is coming,  
it will be borne by this heart of iron.[/p]
